inventoryConventions.battery: One removable hub battery visibly installed on robot PDF p3; not a numbered callout and excluded from158 rollup.
inventoryConventions.cables: Attached motor/sensor cables counted with device assemblies, not separately. No USB cable added by numbered steps.
inventoryConventions.containers: Set storage box on PDF p2 is not assembled into model and is excluded.
inventoryConventions.samples: Package sample8 items excluded from sorter158. Book2 step58 references their placement; it does not duplicate their inventory.
inventoryConventions.editionWarning: 2021 lesson robot removes two knob pegs, so numbered-callout model sum becomes156 if that edition is deliberately chosen.
inventoryConventions.quantityVsIdentity: Counts derive from printed x callouts. Names are visually identified. Exact design and color-element identifiers not given; null means unknown, not absent.
inventoryConventions.geometryResolution: lego-part-crosswalk.json families/sourceCorrections, input + build package-sorter + stable key. geometryId is the LDraw DAT basename, not a certified LEGO design/element ID. Corrected descriptions supersede misleading gray/length keys without changing quantities, instance IDs, source steps or hashes; historical mold and assembled-transform uncertainty remain.

joints.parent: fixed robot platform / large motor casing
joints.child: book2 frame, arm linkage, sensor mast, forks

joints.type: revolute input with bilateral constrained linkage
joints.parent: book2 motor casing and supporting frame
joints.axis: horizontal/transverse to forward fork direction in illustrated assembly

mechanism.passiveJoints: Axle/pin revolutes and two track rods couple opposite sides of fork linkage. No separate powered grip, linear slide or conveyor. A complete passive-joint graph and exact link transform matrices are not supplied and have not been reconstructed.
mechanism.gearing: One angled gear wheel z28 added to sorter book2 step15; no second meshing gear is introduced in the sorter BOM. Do not invent a reduction ratio from the presence of this gear. The two double-conical z36 package gears are sample object bases, not transmission gears. Identity comparison: official 45678 element overview p1 versus base PDF p17 and packages PDF p5.
mechanism.sensor: Color sensor fixed high on twin black15m mast, facing inward toward raised sample region; cable routes to D. No distance or force sensor in numbered inventory.
mechanism.grasp: Two rigid fork prongs support the sample gear base; no independent opening/closing gripper actuator.

mountingRelations.description: Yellow panel fixed to hub at rear, azure large frame extends front; magenta frames extend laterally with upright package pedestals.
Large motor lies on panel with output axis vertical, magenta output biscuit uppermost.
Book2 black frame seats on two blue friction pins carried by that output biscuit; entire arm unit rotates relative to fixed platform.

Two yellow7/gray5 output axles extend on opposite motor sides; rods and angle beams constrain fork support; sensor mast at rear, prongs point forward toward empty azure catch-bin frame in shown home view.

mechanism.dimensions: Manual length markers identify module counts for selected beams and axles, not millimetre CAD dimensions, clearances, detailed hole transforms, complete mass/inertia, material/friction or cable bend geometry.

documentedProgram.pythonDifference: Python ends by returning A to0 then F to240; block SVG ends F240 then A0. Python reset between packages also states A0 then F240. Record source-specific order, not a single invented algorithm.
documentedProgram.angleMeaning: motor encoder absolute target positions, not measured rigid-body world angles or published joint limits
documentedProgram.documentedBehavior: One package from each side; test magenta, place accepted item in front bin, otherwise lower and shake three times to drop. Two specimens, one color acceptance branch, not general multi-color routing.
notDocumentedAsCanonical: a bin for every detected color
documentedProgram.extensionEvidence: Lesson explicitly calls solutions open-ended, asks teams to add functions, and proposes delivery carts/combined models as extensions.

uncertainties: Exact manufacturer element/design IDs and official color IDs remain uncertified; older survey references are not certified sorter SKUs. Motor numeric positions in program are encoder targets, not mechanical hard-stop limits.
